transcript.text: Compliance has an exception to report. I reviewed the applicable collateral-investment mandate this week and found that the $25 million in cash collateral may only be placed in government Treasury bills or AAA-rated bank certificates of deposit, each with a maturity of no more than 14 days. The proposed 30-day commercial paper from Delta Financial does not meet these requirements on two counts: it's not an eligible instrument, and its 30-day maturity exceeds the 14-day limit. This restriction has not yet been added to the desk's pre-trade checklist, which is why it wasn't flagged earlier. The proposed investment cannot proceed from a compliance perspective.

transcript.text: Client coverage has an exception to report. I received a client instruction confirmed by email this morning requiring $7,000,000 of this collateral pool to remain uninvested cash because the client expects a possible securities-loan recall. I have not yet attached the email to the reinvestment ticket. This means any reinvestment plan must account for only $18,000,000 being available for investment, with $7,000,000 held as uninvested cash.
